context.en-US: E2F factors are proliferation-driving transcription factors silenced by RB1 in arrest. Classification groups the family.
context.zh-TW: E2F 因子是在停滯中被 RB1 沉默的增殖驅動轉錄因子。歸類統合此家族。

context.en-US: FOXO3 is a longevity-associated forkhead transcription factor regulated by acetylation. Note-canonical spelling kept; cross-file FOXO3a variance noted.
context.zh-TW: FOXO3 是受乙醯化調節的長壽相關叉頭轉錄因子。保留筆記典型拼寫；跨檔案 FOXO3a 差異已註記。

context.en-US: Transactivation domains recruit P300/CBP coactivator complexes, documented for p53-P300. Recruitment couples TFs to acetylation machinery.
context.zh-TW: 轉活化結構域招募 P300/CBP 協同活化複合體，p53-P300 已記載。招募將轉錄因子耦合到乙醯化機器。

context.en-US: NF-kB is the master transcriptional regulator of SASP genes with activity rising with age. Active-voice driver edge complementing the regulated_by reverse.
context.zh-TW: NF-κB 是 SASP 基因的主要轉錄調節因子，活性隨年齡上升。主動語態驅動邊補充 regulated_by 反向。

context.en-US: Epigenetic drift causes stochastic expression change and loss of cellular identity. Disruption is the transcriptional consequence of drift.
context.zh-TW: 表觀遺傳漂移造成隨機表現變化與細胞身份喪失。破壞是漂移的轉錄後果。

context.en-US: P-TEFb (CDK9/Cyclin T1) phosphorylates the Pol II CTD to release promoter-proximal pausing. Activation is the elongation checkpoint.
context.zh-TW: P-TEFb（CDK9/Cyclin T1）磷酸化 Pol II CTD 以釋放啟動子近端暫停。活化是延伸檢查點。

context.en-US: E2F targets such as MCM2, PCNA and CCNA2 are silenced via SAHF heterochromatinization in senescence. Silencing is the chromatin-execution leg.
context.zh-TW: E2F 標的如 MCM2、PCNA 與 CCNA2 在衰老中經由 SAHF 異染色質化沉默。沉默是染色質執行分支。

context.en-US: Decitabine is a deoxyribose DNMT inhibitor in the same epidrug class as 5-Azacytidine. Classification parallels the 5-Azacytidine edge.
context.zh-TW: Decitabine 是與 5-Azacytidine 同屬表觀藥類別的去氧核糖 DNMT 抑制劑。歸類與 5-Azacytidine 邊平行。

context.en-US: JQ1 is the prototype BET inhibitor displacing BRD4 from acetylated histones and suppressing MYC. Tool-compound edge of the BET axis.
context.zh-TW: JQ1 是將 BRD4 從乙醯化組蛋白移開並抑制 MYC 的原型 BET 抑制劑。BET 軸的工具化合物邊。

context.en-US: JQ1 suppression of MYC transcription implies BRD4-driven MYC output. Promotion is the inferred driver direction.
context.zh-TW: JQ1 對 MYC 轉錄的抑制意味 BRD4 驅動的 MYC 輸出。促進是推斷的驅動方向。

context.en-US: Pinometostat inhibits DOT1L targeting H3K79 methylation in MLL leukemias. Drug-target edge of the methyltransferase axis.
context.zh-TW: Pinometostat 抑制 DOT1L，標靶 MLL 白血病的 H3K79 甲基化。甲基轉移酶軸的藥物—標的邊。

context.en-US: Epidrugs synergize with immunotherapy via MHC-I/PD-L1 upregulation. Upregulation is the immune-visibility mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 表觀藥物經由 MHC-I/PD-L1 上調與免疫治療協同。上調是免疫可見性機制。

context.en-US: Yamanaka factors are the stated drivers of somatic epigenetic resetting. Induction records the reprogramming-to-chromatin direction.
context.zh-TW: 山中因子是體細胞表觀遺傳重置的既定驅動者。誘發記錄重編程到染色質的方向。

context.en-US: Valproate promotes remodeling as an HDAC-inhibiting agent boosting reprogramming. Promotion covers its experimental modulator role.
context.zh-TW: 丙戊酸作為促進重編程的 HDAC 抑制劑推動重塑。促進涵蓋其實驗調節者角色。

context.en-US: DNA methylation is the primary carrier of mitotically heritable epigenetic states. Mechanism edge parallels the Epigenetics parent.
context.zh-TW: DNA 甲基化是有絲分裂可遺傳表觀遺傳狀態的主要載體。機制邊與 Epigenetics 母項平行。

context.en-US: Genomic imprinting is parent-of-origin germline epigenetic inheritance. Classification nests imprinting in heritable regulation.
context.zh-TW: 基因組銘印是親源種系表觀遺傳繼承。歸類將銘印嵌套於可遺傳調節。

context.en-US: DNMT1 propagates methylation states through cell division as maintenance methyltransferase. Maintenance is the inheritance mechanism.
context.zh-TW: DNMT1 作為維持甲基轉移酶在細胞分裂中傳播甲基化狀態。維持是繼承機制。

context.en-US: The cohesin ring complex holds sister chromatids together from replication to anaphase. Maintenance is the canonical ring function; canonical filename used.
context.zh-TW: cohesin 環複合體從複製到後期將姐妹染色單體繫在一起。維持是典型的環功能；使用典型檔名。

context.en-US: Cohesin cooperates with CTCF in loop-extruded TAD boundary formation. Interaction organizes three-dimensional genome architecture.
context.zh-TW: Cohesin 與 CTCF 在環擠出 TAD 邊界形成協作。交互作用組織三維基因組架構。

context.en-US: Cohesin-CTCF loop extrusion organizes TAD compartments. Full canonical name used to avoid a TAD node split.
context.zh-TW: Cohesin-CTCF 環擠出組織 TAD 區室。使用完整典型名稱以免 TAD 節點分裂。

context.en-US: Meiotic REC8/SMC1β cohesin is essential for chromosome segregation. Requirement covers the germline division role.
context.zh-TW: 減數分裂 REC8/SMC1β cohesin 對染色體分離必要。必要性涵蓋種系分裂角色。

context.en-US: Separase cleaves RAD21 to release cohesin at anaphase onset. Removal triggers sister separation.
context.zh-TW: Separase 切割 RAD21 在後期開始釋放 cohesin。移除觸發姐妹分離。

context.en-US: The NIPBL loader deposits cohesin; NIPBL mutation causes Cornelia de Lange syndrome. Regulation is the loading control.
context.zh-TW: NIPBL 裝載器沉積 cohesin；NIPBL 突變導致 Cornelia de Lange 症候群。調節是裝載控制。

context.en-US: Progressive cohesin degradation drives oocyte and somatic aneuploidy with age. Decline links chromatin architecture to aging.
context.zh-TW: 漸進性 cohesin 降解隨年齡驅動卵母細胞與體細胞非整倍體。衰退將染色質架構連結到老化。

context.en-US: Cohesin holds sister chromatids in proximity for homologous-recombination repair of breaks. Requirement serves genome integrity.
context.zh-TW: Cohesin 將姐妹染色單體保持鄰近以進行斷裂的同源重組修復。必要性服務基因組完整。

context.en-US: CHD4 is the essential ATPase remodeling subunit of NuRD. Containment records the complex composition.
context.zh-TW: CHD4 是 NuRD 必要的 ATPase 重塑次單元。包含記錄複合體組成。

context.en-US: HDAC1/2 provide the deacetylase arm of NuRD, normalized to the existing filename. Containment records the dual enzyme machinery.
context.zh-TW: HDAC1/2 提供 NuRD 的去乙醯化酶臂，正規化至既有檔名。包含記錄雙酶機器。

context.en-US: Chromatin remodeling by NuRD is its stated central biological role. Contribution covers the remodeling output.
context.zh-TW: NuRD 的染色質重塑是其既定的中央生物角色。貢獻涵蓋重塑輸出。

context.en-US: NuRD compacts chromatin substrate, paralleling the Deacetylation-condenses-Chromatin edge. Condensation is the structural output.
context.zh-TW: NuRD 壓縮染色質受質，與去乙醯化濃縮染色質邊平行。濃縮是結構輸出。

context.en-US: DGCR8 and Drosha are substrate-recognition and catalytic partners of the Microprocessor, documented by RNAi and co-IP. Interaction is the complex assembly.
context.zh-TW: DGCR8 與 Drosha 是 Microprocessor 的受質辨識與催化夥伴，RNAi 與 co-IP 已記載。交互作用是複合體組裝。

context.en-US: DGCR8 knockout globally abolishes microRNA production. Essentiality makes it the biogenesis gatekeeper.
context.zh-TW: DGCR8 敲除全面廢除 microRNA 產生。必要性使其成為生物生成守門員。

context.en-US: The DGCR8 gene lies in the DiGeorge critical region. Association records the genomic disease link.
context.zh-TW: DGCR8 基因位於 DiGeorge 關鍵區域。關聯記錄基因組疾病連結。

context.en-US: DGCR8 loss prevents silencing of Oct4/Sox2/Nanog on differentiation. Suppression operates via miRNA-mediated exit control.
context.zh-TW: DGCR8 缺失阻止分化時 Oct4/Sox2/Nanog 的沉默。抑制經由 miRNA 介導的退出控制運作。

context.en-US: Microprocessor signaling acts upstream of AIM2 inflammasome activation in pulmonary fibrosis models. Activation is document-backed and specific.
context.zh-TW: Microprocessor 訊號在肺纖維化模型中作用於 AIM2 發炎體活化上游。活化有文獻支持且特異。

context.en-US: Dicer performs the canonical RNase III maturation of pre-let-7. Child edge of the existing Dicer-processes-MicroRNA triple.
context.zh-TW: Dicer 執行 pre-let-7 典型的 RNase III 成熟。是既有 Dicer 處理 MicroRNA triple 的子邊。

context.en-US: ZCCHC11 uridylates pre-let-7 downstream of Lin28 recruitment, destabilizing it. Consolidated inhibits form; downregulates variant dropped.
context.zh-TW: ZCCHC11 在 Lin28 招募下游使 pre-let-7 尿苷化使其不穩定。合併的 inhibits 形式；downregulates 變體捨棄。

context.en-US: let-7 drives differentiation as the inverse of pluripotency maintenance. Promotion is the established pro-differentiation role.
context.zh-TW: let-7 作為多能性維持的反面驅動分化。促進是既定的促分化角色。

context.en-US: let-7 inversely regulates the pluripotent state via pluripotency-factor targeting. Suppression completes the bistable switch.
context.zh-TW: let-7 經由多能性因子標靶反向調節多能性狀態。抑制完成雙穩態開關。

context.en-US: HGF is the sole high-affinity ligand activating the c-Met receptor. Ligand-receptor exclusivity defines the module.
context.zh-TW: HGF 是活化 c-Met 受體的唯一高親和力配體。配體—受體專一性定義模組。

context.en-US: c-Met is definitionally a receptor tyrosine kinase. Classification is textbook.
context.zh-TW: c-Met 定義上是受體酪胺酸激酶。歸類為教科書等級。

context.en-US: c-Met drives motility and invasion via the FAK effector route. Parallel edge to the Integrin-FAK activation.
context.zh-TW: c-Met 經由 FAK 效應路徑驅動遷移與侵襲。與 Integrin-FAK 活化平行的邊。

context.en-US: RAS/MAPK is a canonical c-Met effector arm for proliferation. Activation covers the mitogenic output.
context.zh-TW: RAS/MAPK 是 c-Met 增殖的典型效應臂。活化涵蓋促有絲分裂輸出。

context.en-US: c-Met deregulation is oncogenic across tumor types. Promotion records the transforming consequence.
context.zh-TW: c-Met 失調在多種腫瘤致癌。促進記錄轉化後果。

context.en-US: HGF is the principal activator waking quiescent satellite cells after injury. Activation is the niche injury signal.
context.zh-TW: HGF 是損傷後喚醒靜止衛星細胞的主要活化因子。活化是微環境損傷訊號。

context.en-US: CORRECTED SUBJECT: the receptor protein c-Met, not the MET gene, is the HGF receptor. Replaces the wrong-subject MET-gene edge.
context.zh-TW: 修正主詞：HGF 受體是受體蛋白 c-Met 而非 MET 基因。取代主詞錯誤的 MET 基因邊。

context.en-US: HGF drives the canonical liver repair response after injury. Promotion is its eponymous regenerative function.
context.zh-TW: HGF 在損傷後驅動典型的肝臟修復反應。促進是其名符其實的再生功能。

context.en-US: As scatter factor HGF drives epithelial scattering and motility. Promotion covers the motogenic output.
context.zh-TW: 作為散射因子，HGF 驅動上皮散射與遷移。促進涵蓋促遷移輸出。

context.en-US: HGF is sequestered in the ECM and released upon muscle injury. Localization records the niche reservoir.
context.zh-TW: HGF 被隔離於 ECM 並在肌肉損傷時釋放。定位記錄微環境儲庫。

context.en-US: FAK-dependent adhesion turnover is the core motility process. Promotion is the defining FAK output.
context.zh-TW: FAK 依賴的黏附更新是核心遷移過程。促進是定義性的 FAK 輸出。

context.en-US: FAK assembles as the kinase hub of focal adhesions. Localization records the adhesion signaling platform.
context.zh-TW: FAK 作為黏著斑的激酶樞紐組裝。定位記錄黏附訊號平台。

context.en-US: FAK drives metastasis programs and is a therapeutic target. Promotion covers the oncogenic output.
context.zh-TW: FAK 驅動轉移程序且為治療標靶。促進涵蓋致癌輸出。

context.en-US: The FAK-EMT axis links adhesion signaling to transition programs. Weaker note text, strong general knowledge.
context.zh-TW: FAK-EMT 軸將黏附訊號連結到轉換程序。筆記文字較弱，一般知識強。

context.en-US: Integrins are the transmembrane ECM receptors of focal adhesions. Containment records the adhesion composition.
context.zh-TW: Integrin 是黏著斑的跨膜 ECM 受體。包含記錄黏附組成。

context.en-US: Adhesion assembly-turnover cycles drive cell motility. Promotion is the motility output.
context.zh-TW: 黏附組裝—更新循環驅動細胞遷移。促進是遷移輸出。

context.en-US: Focal adhesions link to and organize actin stress fibers for force transmission. Organization is the cytoskeletal output.
context.zh-TW: 黏著斑連結並組織肌動蛋白應力纖維以傳遞力量。組織是細胞骨架輸出。

context.en-US: Focal adhesions contact ECM ligand substrate; binding proper is integrin-mediated so interacts_with is used. Contact without overstating mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 黏著斑接觸 ECM 配體受質；結合本身由 integrin 介導故用 interacts_with。接觸而不誇大機制。

context.en-US: E-cadherin is the primary epithelial transmembrane protein of adherens junctions. Containment records the junction composition.
context.zh-TW: E-cadherin 是黏附連接的主要上皮跨膜蛋白。包含記錄連接組成。

context.en-US: Loss of junctional integrity defines EMT execution. Disruption is the structural hallmark of transition.
context.zh-TW: 連接完整性喪失定義 EMT 執行。破壞是轉換的結構標誌。

context.en-US: E-cadherin binds beta-catenin as the structural linker coupling adhesion to Wnt signaling. Canonical filename β-Catenin used.
context.zh-TW: E-cadherin 結合 beta-catenin 作為耦合黏附與 Wnt 訊號的結構連接。使用典型檔名 β-Catenin。

context.en-US: Alpha-catenin mechanosensitively links the cadherin complex to actin filaments. Protein-level orphan edge, documented mechanism.
context.zh-TW: Alpha-catenin 以機械敏感方式將 cadherin 複合體連結到肌動蛋白絲。蛋白層級孤兒邊，機制有記載。

context.en-US: Cadherin-mediated niche adhesion maintains stem-cell quiescence per the quiescence document. Maintenance is the niche signal.
context.zh-TW: Cadherin 介導的微環境黏附依靜止文獻維持幹細胞靜止。維持是微環境訊號。

context.en-US: Differential cadherin adhesion drives developmental cell sorting. Driving records the morphogenetic output.
context.zh-TW: 差異 cadherin 黏附驅動發育細胞分選。驅動記錄形態發生輸出。

context.en-US: Cadherin contact signaling enforces proliferation control at confluence. Enforcement is the density-control mechanism.
context.zh-TW: Cadherin 接觸訊號在匯合時執行增殖控制。執行是密度控制機制。

context.en-US: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
context.zh-TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

context.en-US: E-cadherin re-expression is the essential MET endpoint for iPSC cell-cell contacts. Requirement gates reprogramming on adhesion.
context.zh-TW: E-cadherin 重新表現是 iPSC 細胞間接觸必要的 MET 終點。必要性將重編程門控於黏附。

context.en-US: Promoter CpG hypermethylation silences CDH1 in epithelial cancers. Silencing is the epigenetic inactivation route.
context.zh-TW: 啟動子 CpG 高甲基化在上皮癌沉默 CDH1。沉默是表觀遺傳失活路徑。

context.en-US: Germline CDH1 loss causes hereditary diffuse gastric cancer. Suppression records the tumor-suppressor function.
context.zh-TW: 生殖系 CDH1 缺失導致遺傳性瀰漫型胃癌。抑制記錄腫瘤抑制功能。

context.en-US: Demethylation by 5-Azacytidine reactivates silenced CDH1; inference from drug listing, capped. Reactivation is the epidrug mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 5-Azacytidine 去甲基化重新活化沉默的 CDH1；自藥物列表的推斷，設上限。重新活化是表觀藥物機制。

context.en-US: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
context.zh-TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

context.en-US: N-cadherin induction is the mesenchymal marker arm of the cadherin switch. Upregulation defines transition direction.
context.zh-TW: N-cadherin 誘發是 cadherin 轉換的間質標記臂。上調定義轉換方向。

context.en-US: Cadherin-switch reciprocity: N-cadherin rises as E-cadherin falls. Opposition records the switch logic.
context.zh-TW: Cadherin 轉換互反：N-cadherin 上升而 E-cadherin 下降。對立記錄轉換邏輯。

context.en-US: N-cadherin engagement drives FGFR survival and motility signaling at the protein level; CDH2 gene used as canonical subject. Activation is the motility output.
context.zh-TW: N-cadherin 結合在蛋白層級驅動 FGFR 存活與遷移訊號；CDH2 基因用作典型主詞。活化是遷移輸出。

context.en-US: FGFR-mediated motility downstream of CDH2/N-cadherin promotes migration. Capped promotion edge.
context.zh-TW: CDH2/N-cadherin 下游 FGFR 介導的遷移促進移動。設上限的促進邊。

context.en-US: Myosin motors interact with actin filaments in stress fibers and contractility. Interaction is the motor-filament pairing.
context.zh-TW: Myosin 馬達在應力纖維與收縮中與肌動蛋白絲交互作用。交互作用是馬達—絲配對。

context.en-US: Cofilin severs filaments to promote depolymerization and turnover. Disruption is the remodeling input.
context.zh-TW: Cofilin 切斷絲以促進去聚合與更新。破壞是重塑輸入。

context.en-US: EMT executes massive actin remodeling for motility. Involvement places the cytoskeleton in transition.
context.zh-TW: EMT 為遷移執行大規模肌動蛋白重塑。涉及將細胞骨架置於轉換。

context.en-US: Fibroblasts are the principal ECM-producing cells depositing collagens and matrix. Canonical plural filename used. Production is their tissue function.
context.zh-TW: Fibroblasts 是沉積膠原與基質的主要 ECM 產生細胞。使用典型複數檔名。產生是其組織功能。

context.en-US: ECM ligands engage and activate integrin receptors, completing the ECM-Integrin-FAK chain. Activation is the outside-in trigger.
context.zh-TW: ECM 配體接合併活化 integrin 受體，完成 ECM-Integrin-FAK 鏈。活化是由外而內的觸發。

context.en-US: Pathological ECM over-deposition defines fibrotic scarring. Accumulation is the disease criterion.
context.zh-TW: 病理性 ECM 過度沉積定義纖維化疤痕。累積是疾病判準。

context.en-US: Niche ECM signaling helps maintain quiescent stem states; capped since the document credits the whole niche. Maintenance is partial.
context.zh-TW: 微環境 ECM 訊號協助維持靜止幹細胞狀態；因文獻歸功整體微環境而設上限。維持為部分。

context.en-US: Basal lamina is a specialized sheet form of extracellular matrix. Classification nests it in ECM.
context.zh-TW: 基底膜是細胞外基質的特化片狀形式。歸類將它嵌套於 ECM。

context.en-US: Laminin is a major structural and signaling component of basal lamina. Containment records the sheet composition.
context.zh-TW: Laminin 是基底膜的主要結構與訊號成分。包含記錄片狀組成。

context.en-US: Collagen IV forms the network scaffold of basal lamina sheets. Containment records the scaffold.
context.zh-TW: Collagen IV 形成基底膜片的網絡支架。包含記錄支架。

context.en-US: Integrins are the primary receptors anchoring cells to basal lamina. Binding records the adhesion pairing.
context.zh-TW: Integrin 是將細胞錨定至基底膜的主要受體。結合記錄黏附配對。

context.en-US: Laminin concentrates in the basement-membrane layer of basal lamina. Part-whole nesting of the component.
context.zh-TW: Laminin 集中於基底膜的基底膜層。成分的部分—整體嵌套。

context.en-US: Integrins are the primary receptors transducing laminin signals. Binding is the signal-entry pairing.
context.zh-TW: Integrin 是傳導 laminin 訊號的主要受體。結合是訊號進入配對。

context.en-US: Laminin mediates cell adhesion as a stated adhesive process. Promotion is the adhesive output.
context.zh-TW: Laminin 介導細胞黏附作為既定的黏附過程。促進是黏附輸出。

context.en-US: p53 is the definitional tumor suppressor gene of cancer biology. Classification is textbook.
context.zh-TW: p53 是癌症生物學定義性的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類為教科書等級。

context.en-US: RB1 is the Knudson two-hit archetype tumor suppressor. Classification is historical and textbook.
context.zh-TW: RB1 是 Knudson 二擊原型腫瘤抑制基因。歸類具歷史與教科書地位。

context.en-US: CDKN2A (p16INK4a locus) is an archetypal tumor suppressor. Classification groups it with p53/RB1.
context.zh-TW: CDKN2A（p16INK4a 基因座）是典型的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類將它與 p53/RB1 並列。

context.en-US: Promoter CpG hypermethylation silences tumor suppressor genes in cancer. Silencing is the epigenetic inactivation route.
context.zh-TW: 啟動子 CpG 高甲基化在癌症沉默腫瘤抑制基因。沉默是表觀遺傳失活路徑。

context.en-US: Tumor suppressor genes protect cells from neoplastic transformation. Suppression is the defining gatekeeper function.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤抑制基因保護細胞免於贅生性轉化。抑制是定義性的守門功能。

context.en-US: p53/RB1 tumor-suppressor backbone enforces senescent arrest; inactivation is the escape route. Enforcement is the checkpoint output.
context.zh-TW: p53/RB1 腫瘤抑制主幹執行衰老停滯；失活是逃脫路徑。執行是檢查點輸出。

context.en-US: Demethylating Decitabine reactivates silenced tumor suppressors; capped inference. Reactivation is the epidrug mechanism.
context.zh-TW: 去甲基化 Decitabine 重新活化沉默的腫瘤抑制基因；設上限的推斷。重新活化是表觀藥物機制。

context.en-US: Senescence restricts fibrotic expansion per Krizhanovsky wound models. Limitation is the protective face of arrest.
context.zh-TW: 衰老依 Krizhanovsky 傷口模型限制纖維化擴張。限制是停滯的保護面。

context.en-US: Chronic immune activation sustains fibrogenic programs. Promotion is the inflammatory feed into scarring.
context.zh-TW: 慢性免疫活化維持纖維化生成程序。促進是發炎對疤痕的供養。

context.en-US: Collagen is the primary overproduced ECM protein of fibrotic scars. Accumulation defines the lesion.
context.zh-TW: 膠原是纖維化疤痕主要過度產生的 ECM 蛋白。累積定義病灶。

context.en-US: EMT supplies myofibroblast pools feeding fibrotic expansion. Contribution is the lineage input.
context.zh-TW: EMT 供應肌纖維母細胞池供養纖維化擴張。貢獻是譜系輸入。

context.en-US: SIRT1 blocks hepatic stellate cell activation to oppose fibrosis. Antagonism is the sirtuin protective output.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 阻斷肝星狀細胞活化以對抗纖維化。拮抗是 sirtuin 保護輸出。

context.en-US: Snail (SNAI1) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Driving is the defining transcription program.
context.zh-TW: Snail（SNAI1）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。驅動是定義性轉錄程序。

context.en-US: Snail repression of E-cadherin is the defining EMT molecular event; proposed once here, CDH1 side marked covered. Repression executes transition.
context.zh-TW: Snail 對 E-cadherin 的抑制是定義性的 EMT 分子事件；僅在此提案一次，CDH1 側標記已涵蓋。抑制執行轉換。

context.en-US: Snail is a SNAI-family zinc-finger transcription factor. Classification defines the family.
context.zh-TW: Snail 是 SNAI 家族鋅指轉錄因子。歸類定義家族。

context.en-US: Snail drives invasion and stemness programs in carcinoma progression. Promotion covers the malignant output.
context.zh-TW: Snail 在癌進展驅動侵襲與幹性程序。促進涵蓋惡性輸出。

context.en-US: OSKM-driven Snail suppression enables MET during reprogramming. Suppression is the MET-permissive input.
context.zh-TW: OSKM 驅動的 Snail 抑制在重編程促成 MET。抑制是 MET 許可輸入。

context.en-US: Slug (SNAI2) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Parallel driver to Snail.
context.zh-TW: Slug（SNAI2）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。與 Snail 平行的驅動者。

context.en-US: Slug is a SNAI-family zinc-finger transcription factor. Classification defines the family.
context.zh-TW: Slug 是 SNAI 家族鋅指轉錄因子。歸類定義家族。

context.en-US: SNAI2 E-box repression of CDH1 is established EMT mechanism. Repression parallels the Snail edge.
context.zh-TW: SNAI2 E-box 對 CDH1 的抑制是既定的 EMT 機制。抑制與 Snail 邊平行。

context.en-US: Slug drives invasion and stemness programs. Promotion covers the malignant output.
context.zh-TW: Slug 驅動侵襲與幹性程序。促進涵蓋惡性輸出。

context.en-US: Zeb1 is a core E-box-binding driver of EMT. Driving defines its transition role.
context.zh-TW: Zeb1 是 EMT 的核心 E-box 結合驅動者。驅動定義其轉換角色。

context.en-US: Zeb1 E-box binding represses CDH1 transcription. Repression is the established mechanism.
context.zh-TW: Zeb1 E-box 結合抑制 CDH1 轉錄。抑制是既定機制。

context.en-US: Zeb1 is a zinc-finger E-box-binding transcription factor. Classification defines the family.
context.zh-TW: Zeb1 是鋅指 E-box 結合轉錄因子。歸類定義家族。

context.en-US: Zeb1 drives invasion and stemness in carcinoma progression. Promotion covers the malignant output.
context.zh-TW: Zeb1 在癌進展驅動侵襲與幹性。促進涵蓋惡性輸出。

context.en-US: TGF-beta SMAD signaling activates Zeb1 as the upstream EMT input. Activation positions SMAD above Zeb1.
context.zh-TW: TGF-beta SMAD 訊號活化 Zeb1 作為上游 EMT 輸入。活化將 SMAD 置於 Zeb1 上方。

context.en-US: Sodium butyrate inhibits class I/IIa HDACs, raising H3/H4 acetylation; mirrors the Trichostatin A edge. Consolidated single edge from two miners.
context.zh-TW: Sodium butyrate 抑制 I/IIa 類 HDAC，提高 H3/H4 乙醯化；呼應 Trichostatin A 邊。兩位礦工合併的單一邊。

context.en-US: Millimolar butyrate induces SA-beta-gal/SAHF/p21 arrest; mirrors the Gemcitabine senescence edge. Dose-defined HDACi outcome.
context.zh-TW: 毫莫耳 butyrate 誘發 SA-beta-gal/SAHF/p21 停滯；呼應 Gemcitabine 衰老邊。劑量定義的 HDACi 結果。

context.en-US: Butyrate activates CDKN1A via promoter H3K9ac/H4K12ac; canonical object CDKN1A used for alias p21. Upregulation is the arrest effector.
context.zh-TW: Butyrate 經由啟動子 H3K9ac/H4K12ac 活化 CDKN1A；別名 p21 使用典型物件 CDKN1A。上調是停滯效應器。

context.en-US: Phenylbutyrate inhibits class I/IIA HDACs at stress-response promoters. Same inhibitor class as butyrate and valproate.
context.zh-TW: Phenylbutyrate 在壓力反應啟動子抑制 I/IIA 類 HDAC。與 butyrate 和 valproate 相同的抑制劑類別。

context.en-US: Hsp70 is the major transcriptional target of phenylbutyrate mediating cytoprotection and refolding. Upregulation is the chaperone output.
context.zh-TW: Hsp70 是 phenylbutyrate 介導細胞保護與重折疊的主要轉錄標的。上調是伴侶輸出。

context.en-US: Phenylbutyrate is an HDAC-inhibitor member of the epigenetic-modifier class per senescence-compound classification. Classification groups the butyrates.
context.zh-TW: Phenylbutyrate 依衰老化合物分類是表觀遺傳修飾類別的 HDAC 抑制成員。歸類統合 butyrate 類。

context.en-US: Sublethal busulfan is a standard in-vitro senescence inducer via p53/p21 arrest. Same inducer class as other alkylators.
context.zh-TW: 亞致死 busulfan 是經由 p53/p21 停滯的標準體外衰老誘發因子。與其他烷化劑相同的誘發類別。

context.en-US: Bifunctional busulfan forms guanine-N7 interstrand crosslinks triggering DDR. Damage is the upstream lesion.
context.zh-TW: 雙功能 busulfan 形成鳥嘌呤 N7 鏈間交聯觸發 DDR。損傷是上游病變。

context.en-US: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
context.zh-TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

context.en-US: Mustard-induced lesions resolve into apoptosis as a major outcome. Death is the cytotoxic output.
context.zh-TW: 芥子誘發的損傷以凋亡為主要結果消解。死亡是細胞毒性輸出。

context.en-US: Senescence is the documented alternate fate of cyclophosphamide damage. Alternate outcome to death.
context.zh-TW: 衰老是 cyclophosphamide 損傷記載的替代命運。死亡之外的替代結果。

context.en-US: Diaziquone is an aziridinylbenzoquinone crosslinker in the alkylator class. Classification by mechanism.
context.zh-TW: Diaziquone 是烷化劑類別中的 aziridinylbenzoquinone 交聯劑。依機制歸類。

context.en-US: Diaziquone induces senescence via NQO1-bioactivated ROS and DNA damage. Bioactivation is the trigger route.
context.zh-TW: Diaziquone 經由 NQO1 生物活化的 ROS 與 DNA 損傷誘發衰老。生物活化是觸發路徑。

context.en-US: Mitomycin C is a prototypical intra- plus interstrand crosslinker. Classification defines the drug.
context.zh-TW: Mitomycin C 是原型的鏈內加鏈間交聯劑。歸類定義藥物。

context.en-US: Mitomycin C drives senescence via replication stress and DDR signaling. Stress-to-arrest conversion.
context.zh-TW: Mitomycin C 經由複製壓力與 DDR 訊號驅動衰老。壓力到停滯的轉換。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is the major damage outcome alongside senescence. Dual fate of crosslink damage.
context.zh-TW: 凋亡是與衰老並列的主要損傷結果。交聯損傷的雙重命運。

context.en-US: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
context.zh-TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

context.en-US: Topo II stabilization plus intercalation generates double-strand breaks. Breaks are the cytotoxic lesion.
context.zh-TW: Topo II 穩定加嵌入產生雙股斷裂。斷裂是細胞毒性病變。

context.en-US: Mitoxantrone is an approved immunosuppressive therapy for multiple sclerosis. Indication mirrors the Hydroxyurea-SCD pattern.
context.zh-TW: Mitoxantrone 是多發性硬化症核准的免疫抑制治療。適應症呼應 Hydroxyurea-SCD 模式。

context.en-US: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
context.zh-TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

context.en-US: Replication-dependent DSBs recruit ATM signaling under camptothecin. Kinase activation is the damage readout.
context.zh-TW: 複製依賴的 DSB 在 camptothecin 下招募 ATM 訊號。激酶活化是損傷讀值。

context.en-US: Same fork-collapse lesions recruit ATR alongside ATM. Dual-kinase engagement of the damage.
context.zh-TW: 相同的複製叉崩塌病變同時招募 ATR 與 ATM。損傷的雙激酶接合。

context.en-US: Low-dose camptothecin produces a stable senescent phenotype. Dose-defined arrest outcome.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量 camptothecin 產生穩定的衰老表型。劑量定義的停滯結果。

context.en-US: SAM is the universal methyl donor for DNMT1-mediated 5mC synthesis. Classification defines its metabolic role.
context.zh-TW: SAM 是 DNMT1 介導 5mC 合成的通用甲基供體。歸類定義其代謝角色。

context.en-US: SAH is the stoichiometric byproduct of SAM methyl transfer. Product relation records the reaction balance.
context.zh-TW: SAH 是 SAM 甲基轉移的化學計量副產物。產物關係記錄反應平衡。

context.en-US: UHRF1 recognizes hemi-methylated CpG via its SRA domain to recruit DNMT1. Active-voice inverse of the existing recruited_by edge; novel pair.
context.zh-TW: UHRF1 經由 SRA 結構域辨識半甲基化 CpG 以招募 DNMT1。既有 recruited_by 邊的主動語態反向；新穎配對。

context.en-US: UHRF1 directs maintenance fidelity of methylation through division. Maintenance mirrors the DNMT1 edge.
context.zh-TW: UHRF1 在分裂中指導甲基化的維持保真度。維持呼應 DNMT1 邊。

context.en-US: Methylated satellites seed constitutive heterochromatin for centromere stability. Maintenance is the structural output.
context.zh-TW: 甲基化衛星為著絲粒穩定播種組成型異染色質。維持是結構輸出。

context.en-US: Satellite methylation loss compromises genome stability. Contribution is the integrity output; lowercase canonical kept.
context.zh-TW: 衛星甲基化喪失損害基因組穩定。貢獻是完整性輸出；保留小寫典型。

context.en-US: SIRT6 maintains stability via telomeric H3K9 deacetylation and LINE-1 suppression. Maintenance is the guardian function.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 經由端粒 H3K9 去乙醯化與 LINE-1 抑制維持穩定。維持是守護功能。

context.en-US: High-fidelity DSB repair protects genome integrity. Requirement records the repair dependency.
context.zh-TW: 高保真 DSB 修復保護基因組完整。必要性記錄修復依賴。

context.en-US: DNA-PKcs executes NHEJ repair downstream of SIRT6 mobilization. Maintenance is the end-joining output.
context.zh-TW: DNA-PKcs 在 SIRT6 動員下游執行 NHEJ 修復。維持是末端連接輸出。

context.en-US: Ku70/80 recruitment to DNA ends assembles and activates DNA-PK. Activation is the break-sensing step.
context.zh-TW: Ku70/80 招募至 DNA 末端組裝並活化 DNA-PK。活化是斷裂感知步驟。

context.en-US: SIRT6 promotes DNA-PKcs mobilization and stability at breaks. Regulation is the sirtuin-to-repair coupling.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 促進 DNA-PKcs 在斷裂處的動員與穩定。調節是 sirtuin 到修復的耦合。

context.en-US: High-fidelity homologous repair preserves integrity against breaks. Maintenance is the fidelity output.
context.zh-TW: 高保真同源修復保持對抗斷裂的完整。維持是保真輸出。

context.en-US: BRCA1 drives end resection and pathway choice for homologous repair. Requirement is the mediator dependency.
context.zh-TW: BRCA1 驅動末端切除與同源修復的路徑選擇。必要性是介體依賴。

context.en-US: Derepressed HERV amplifies the senescence secretome via cGAS-STING; mirrors the BRD4-drives-SASP edge. Drive is the retroelement input.
context.zh-TW: 去抑制的 HERV 經由 cGAS-STING 放大衰老分泌組；呼應 BRD4 驅動 SASP 邊。驅動是逆轉錄元件輸入。

context.en-US: HERV-driven signaling feeds chronic low-grade inflammation; mirrors the SASP-inflammaging edge. Contribution is the systemic output.
context.zh-TW: HERV 驅動的訊號供養慢性低度發炎；呼應 SASP-inflammaging 邊。貢獻是全身輸出。

context.en-US: NRTIs block endogenous-retrovirus reverse transcription alongside LINE-1. Inhibition extends the antiretroviral repurposing.
context.zh-TW: NRTI 阻斷內源性逆轉錄病毒逆轉錄，與 LINE-1 並列。抑制延伸抗逆轉錄病毒再利用。

context.en-US: NRTIs dampen retroelement-driven SASP as a senomorphic repurposing mechanism. Suppression is the anti-inflammatory output.
context.zh-TW: NRTI 減弱逆轉錄元件驅動的 SASP 作為 senomorphic 再利用機制。抑制是抗發炎輸出。

context.en-US: Lamivudine is a representative nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor drug. Classification anchors the member.
context.zh-TW: Lamivudine 是代表性的核苷逆轉錄酶抑制藥物。歸類錨定成員。

context.en-US: Antiviral response programs roadblock OSKM reprogramming; mirrors the p53-limits edge. Limitation is the immunity barrier.
context.zh-TW: 抗病毒反應程序阻礙 OSKM 重編程；呼應 p53 限制邊。限制是免疫屏障。

context.en-US: ROS-mediated oxidative DNA damage experimentally links innate sensing to p53. Activation is the sensing-to-checkpoint bridge.
context.zh-TW: ROS 介導的氧化 DNA 損傷在實驗上將先天感知連結到 p53。活化是感知到檢查點的橋樑。

context.en-US: The conserved worm-to-mammal longevity axis dissected in model organisms. Regulation is the endocrine aging input.
context.zh-TW: 在模式生物解剖的保守蠕蟲到哺乳類長壽軸。調節是內分泌老化輸入。

context.en-US: Wnt4 is a niche-derived soluble factor enforcing quiescence (Eliazer 2019); mirrors the RB1-enforces edge. Enforcement is the niche signal.
context.zh-TW: Wnt4 是執行靜止的微環境衍生可溶因子（Eliazer 2019）；呼應 RB1 執行邊。執行是微環境訊號。

context.en-US: FRAT2 binds GSK3β competing with Axin to disrupt the destruction complex. Inhibition releases beta-catenin signaling.
context.zh-TW: FRAT2 結合 GSK3β 與 Axin 競爭以破壞降解複合體。抑制釋放 beta-catenin 訊號。

context.en-US: FRAT2 amplifies canonical beta-catenin signaling toward MYCN stabilization and DNMT3A. Promotion is the cascade input.
context.zh-TW: FRAT2 放大典型 beta-catenin 訊號朝向 MYCN 穩定與 DNMT3A。促進是級聯輸入。

context.en-US: PARP1 is the principal nuclear PARP executing poly-ADP-ribosylation; mirrors the HAT-catalyzes-acetylation edge. Catalysis defines the enzyme.
context.zh-TW: PARP1 是執行 poly-ADP-核糖基化的主要核 PARP；呼應 HAT 催化乙醯化邊。催化定義酶。

context.en-US: PARylation consumes NAD+ as donor, mirroring the HAT-uses-Acetyl-CoA pattern. Substrate use links damage signaling to metabolism.
context.zh-TW: PARylation 消耗 NAD+ 作為供體，呼應 HAT 使用 Acetyl-CoA 模式。受質使用將損傷訊號連結到代謝。

context.en-US: Nanog is a direct ZIC3 target in the pluripotency network. Regulation places ZIC3 upstream of Nanog.
context.zh-TW: Nanog 是多能性網絡中直接的 ZIC3 標的。調節將 ZIC3 置於 Nanog 上游。

subject: Reactive Oxygen Species

context.en-US: Viral transduction generates ROS producing nuclear and mitochondrial 8OHdG foci upstream of p53. Causation is the transduction-to-lesion step.
context.zh-TW: 病毒轉導產生 ROS，在 p53 上游造成核與粒線體 8OHdG 灶。因果是轉導到損傷的步驟。

source_document: _document_ - Molecular Insights into Reprogramming-Initiation Events Mediated by the OSKM Gene Regulatory Network.md

subject: TGF-beta Signaling Pathway

context.en-US: TGF-beta blocks OSKM-driven MET; receptor inhibitor SB431542 raises reprogramming efficiency. Inhibition is the barrier mechanism.
context.zh-TW: TGF-beta 阻斷 OSKM 驅動的 MET；受體抑制劑 SB431542 提高重編程效率。抑制是屏障機制。

source_document: _document_ - Molecular Insights into Reprogramming-Initiation Events Mediated by the OSKM Gene Regulatory Network.md

subject: c-Myc

context.en-US: High c-Myc expression carries tumorigenesis risk motivating 3-factor OSK clinical designs; mirrors the MET-gene edge. Promotion is the safety rationale.
context.zh-TW: 高 c-Myc 表現帶有致瘤風險，促使三因子 OSK 臨床設計；呼應 MET 基因邊。促進是安全依據。

source_document: _document_ - Application of the Yamanaka Transcription Factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc from the Laboratory to the Clinic.md

subject: Faecalibacterium

context.en-US: Faecalibacterium is a major butyrate producer depleted in the oldest-old; ties gut depletion to the butyrate-HDACi axis. Production is the microbiome link.
context.zh-TW: Faecalibacterium 是在最老人群減少的主要丁酸產生菌；將腸道耗竭連結到丁酸-HDACi 軸。產生是微生物組連結。

source_document: _document_ - The Gut Microbiome, Aging, and Longevity A Systematic Review.md

subject: Akkermansia

context.en-US: Akkermansia is the most consistently age/longevity-enriched gut taxon in the systematic review. Association is the cohort signal.
context.zh-TW: Akkermansia 是系統性回顧中最一致隨年齡/長壽富集的腸道分類群。關聯是隊列訊號。

source_document: _document_ - The Gut Microbiome, Aging, and Longevity A Systematic Review.md

subject: CDK Inhibitor

context.en-US: Quiescence-inducing signals act by decreasing Cyclin/CDK activity or raising CDK inhibitor levels; p21/p27/p57 run high in quiescence.
context.zh-TW: 靜止誘導訊號經由降低 Cyclin/CDK 活性或提高 CDK 抑制因子水平作用；p21/p27/p57 在靜止高表現。

source_document: _document_ - Cellular Mechanisms and Regulation of Quiescence.md

subject: Mitophagy

context.en-US: Mitochondrial clearance through mitophagy maintains quiescence; its loss in HSCs causes aberrant cell-cycle re-entry.
context.zh-TW: 經由 mitophagy 的粒線體清除維持靜止；其在 HSC 缺失導致異常細胞週期重入。

source_document: _document_ - Cellular Mechanisms and Regulation of Quiescence.md

subject: TGF-beta1

context.en-US: Niche-derived TGF-beta1 is listed as a quiescence-inducing soluble factor.
context.zh-TW: 微環境衍生的 TGF-beta1 列為靜止誘導可溶因子。

source_document: _document_ - Cellular Mechanisms and Regulation of Quiescence.md

subject: DNA Damage

context.en-US: A fifth of MCF10A cells enter quiescence from inherited replication stress and DNA damage, with arrest duration tracking damage extent.
context.zh-TW: 五分之一 MCF10A 細胞因遺傳的複製壓力與 DNA 損傷進入靜止，停滯时长追蹤損傷程度。

source_document: _document_ - Cellular Mechanisms and Regulation of Quiescence.md

context.en-US: Direct lineage reprogramming converts somatic cells into induced neural stem cells.
context.zh-TW: 直接譜系重編程將體細胞轉化為誘導神經幹細胞。

context.en-US: Direct derivation without a pluripotent intermediate substantially reduces teratoma risk, paralleling partial reprogramming.
context.zh-TW: 不經多能性中間的直接衍生大幅降低畸胎瘤風險，與部分重編程平行。

context.en-US: Forced Sox2 expression is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for conversion to induced neural stem cells.
context.zh-TW: 強制 Sox2 表現對轉化為誘導神經幹細胞常必要、有時充分。

context.en-US: Induced neural stem cells are a leading cell-replacement candidate in stroke, spinal injury and Parkinson models.
context.zh-TW: 誘導神經幹細胞是中風、脊髓損傷與帕金森模型的主要細胞替代候選。

context.en-US: Oocyte factors reset the donor genome to a totipotent and pluripotent state.
context.zh-TW: 卵母細胞因子將供體基因組重置為全能與多能狀態。

context.en-US: Culturing SCNT blastocysts yields nuclear-transfer ESC lines.
context.zh-TW: 培養 SCNT 囊胚產生核轉移 ESC 系。

context.en-US: Disease-specific nuclear-transfer ESCs provide models carrying patient genomes.
context.zh-TW: 疾病特異核轉移 ESC 提供攜帶患者基因組的模型。

context.en-US: Nuclear-transfer ESC derivatives support compound screening on patient genotypes.
context.zh-TW: 核轉移 ESC 衍生物支持患者基因型上的化合物篩選。

context.en-US: Embryonic stem cells are assayed via teratoma formation as gold-standard trilineage proof.
context.zh-TW: 胚胎幹細胞經由畸胎瘤形成測定，作為三胚層黃金標準證據。

context.en-US: The teratoma assay is the canonical in-vivo proof of pluripotency breadth.
context.zh-TW: 畸胎瘤測定是多能性廣度的典型體內證據。

context.en-US: Immature teratomas can harbor malignant components such as yolk-sac tumor.
context.zh-TW: 未成熟畸胎瘤可含有卵黃囊瘤等惡性成分。

context.en-US: Assembloids are built by fusing two or more region-specific organoids.
context.zh-TW: Assembloid 由融合兩個以上區域特異類器官建成。

context.en-US: Assembloids recapitulate migration, circuits and tumor-immune pathophysiology.
context.zh-TW: Assembloid 重現遷移、迴路與腫瘤免疫病理生理。

context.en-US: Region-specific organoids for fusion derive from induced pluripotent stem cells.
context.zh-TW: 供融合的區域特異類器官源自誘導多能幹細胞。

context.en-US: Tumor assembloids fuse tumor organoids with immune and stromal cells.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤 assembloid 將腫瘤類器官與免疫及基質細胞融合。

context.en-US: Patient-specific organoids commonly originate from induced pluripotent stem cells.
context.zh-TW: 患者特異類器官通常源自誘導多能幹細胞。

context.en-US: Organoids are a central platform for monogenic, complex-disease and infection studies.
context.zh-TW: 類器官是單基因、複雜疾病與感染研究的核心平台。

context.en-US: Matrigel and matrix cues establish organoid polarity and architecture.
context.zh-TW: Matrigel 與基質線索建立類器官極性與架構。

context.en-US: Organoids provide a transplantable tissue source for repair.
context.zh-TW: 類器官提供可移植的組織來源以供修復。

context.en-US: Engineered constructs augment endogenous healing of damaged tissue.
context.zh-TW: 工程化構建體增強受損組織的內源癒合。

context.en-US: Patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cells serve as the cell source.
context.zh-TW: 患者特異誘導多能幹細胞充當細胞來源。

context.en-US: ECM-derived hydrogels provide scaffold and signaling context.
context.zh-TW: ECM 衍生水凝膠提供支架與訊號脈絡。

context.en-US: Tissue engineering sits within the broader regenerative-medicine field.
context.zh-TW: 組織工程位於更廣的再生醫學領域之內。

context.en-US: Gene editing is widely used in stem-cell models and isogenic lines.
context.zh-TW: 基因編輯廣泛用於幹細胞模型與同基因系。

context.en-US: Stem-cell research underpins development, disease modeling and drug screening for repair.
context.zh-TW: 幹細胞研究支撐修復的發育、疾病建模與藥物篩選。

context.en-US: Pluripotency circuitry of Oct4/Sox2/Nanog is a central research property.
context.zh-TW: Oct4/Sox2/Nanog 多能性線路是核心研究特性。

context.en-US: High-throughput screening is the primary engine of modern drug discovery campaigns.
context.zh-TW: 高通量篩選是現代藥物發現的主要引擎。

context.en-US: Human induced pluripotent stem cells serve as screening substrates.
context.zh-TW: 人類誘導多能幹細胞充當篩選底物。

context.en-US: High-throughput campaigns discovered senolytics such as the navitoclax class.
context.zh-TW: 高通量篩選發現 navitoclax 類等 senolytic 藥物。

context.en-US: Epigenetic target classes including histone methyltransferases are screened for H3K27me3 modulation.
context.zh-TW: 含組蛋白甲基轉移酶的表觀遺傳標的類被篩選以調節 H3K27me3。

context.en-US: Toxicity testing is the pipeline stage that de-risks drug candidates.
context.zh-TW: 毒性測試是為候選藥物去風險的管線階段。

context.en-US: Human induced pluripotent stem cells provide a human-relevant toxicity platform.
context.zh-TW: 人類誘導多能幹細胞提供人類相關的毒性平台。

context.en-US: High-throughput screening enables large-scale toxicity campaigns.
context.zh-TW: 高通量篩選促成大規模毒性篩選。

context.en-US: Cardiotoxicity is a key safety endpoint alongside drug-induced liver injury.
context.zh-TW: 心臟毒性是與藥物性肝損傷並列的關鍵安全終點。

context.en-US: A haplobank curates HLA-homozygous induced pluripotent stem cell master lines.
context.zh-TW: 單倍庫策展 HLA 純合誘導多能幹細胞主系。

context.en-US: HLA-A/B/DRB1 matching determines transplant compatibility.
context.zh-TW: HLA-A/B/DRB1 配型決定移植相容性。

context.en-US: Fixed release-tested master lines mitigate undifferentiated-iPSC tumor risk.
context.zh-TW: 固定且經放行檢測的主系降低未分化 iPSC 腫瘤風險。

context.en-US: Haplobanks supply off-the-shelf allogeneic cell therapies.
context.zh-TW: 單倍庫供應現貨型異體細胞治療。

context.en-US: HFF1 is a neonatal foreskin fibroblast line.
context.zh-TW: HFF1 是新生兒包皮纖維母細胞系。

context.en-US: HFF1 fibroblasts convert efficiently under defined Yamanaka factors.
context.zh-TW: HFF1 纖維母細胞在既定山中因子下有效轉化。

context.en-US: Defined-factor reprogramming converts HFF1 fibroblasts to pluripotency.
context.zh-TW: 既定因子重編程將 HFF1 纖維母細胞轉為多能性。

context.en-US: HFF1 is a standard reprogramming substrate and pluripotent-culture feeder layer.
context.zh-TW: HFF1 是標準重編程底物與多能培養飼養層。

context.en-US: Isogenic pairs are the gold standard for monogenic causal attribution.
context.zh-TW: 同基因對是單基因因果歸因的黃金標準。

context.en-US: Isogenic pairs commonly start from a parental induced pluripotent stem cell line.
context.zh-TW: 同基因對通常始於親代誘導多能幹細胞系。

context.en-US: Cas9 editing creates the single-locus difference between pairs.
context.zh-TW: Cas9 編輯在配對間創造單位點差異。

context.en-US: Isogenic pairs support genotype-stratified sensitivity and synthetic-lethal screens.
context.zh-TW: 同基因對支持基因型分層敏感性與合成致死篩選。

context.en-US: Fibroblasts drive collagen and glycosaminoglycan synthesis supporting re-epithelialization.
context.zh-TW: 纖維母細胞驅動膠原與糖胺聚醣合成，支持再上皮化。

context.en-US: Proliferative and remodeling phases of wound healing constitute repair.
context.zh-TW: 傷口癒合的增殖與重塑期構成修復。

context.en-US: The hemostasis-to-inflammation wave clears debris and orchestrates repair phases.
context.zh-TW: 止血到發炎波清除碎片並編排修復階段。

context.en-US: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

context.en-US: APC/C bound to CDC20 drives the metaphase-to-anaphase transition with defined specificity.
context.zh-TW: 與 CDC20 結合的 APC/C 以既定特異性驅動中期到後期轉換。

context.en-US: APC/C degrades securin to release separase for sister separation.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 降解 securin 以釋放 separase 分離姐妹染色單體。

context.en-US: APC/C degrades cyclin B, inactivating CDK1 for mitotic exit.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 降解 cyclin B，使 CDK1 失活以退出有絲分裂。

context.en-US: The APC/C is the ultimate effector restrained by the spindle assembly checkpoint via Mad2/BubR1.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 是經 Mad2/BubR1 受紡錘體組裝檢查點約束的最終效應器。

context.en-US: Mad2 inhibits APC/C-CDC20 at unattached kinetochores until biorientation.
context.zh-TW: Mad2 在未附著動點抑制 APC/C-CDC20 直到雙定向。

context.en-US: Ubiquitinated APC/C substrates are degraded by the 26S proteasome.
context.zh-TW: 泛素化的 APC/C 受質被 26S 蛋白酶體降解。

context.en-US: APC/C dysfunction causes missegregation and aneuploid daughter genomes.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 功能障礙導致錯誤分離與非整倍體子基因組。

context.en-US: Persistent APC/C defects drive continuous chromosomal instability.
context.zh-TW: 持續的 APC/C 缺陷驅動連續的染色體不穩定。

context.en-US: APC/C triggers cohesin cleavage via the securin-separase axis.
context.zh-TW: APC/C 經 securin-separase 軸觸發 cohesin 切割。

context.en-US: The cohesin ring holds sister chromatids until anaphase onset.
context.zh-TW: cohesin 環將姐妹染色單體繫在一起直到後期開始。

context.en-US: Sister chromatids are generated during S-phase genome duplication.
context.zh-TW: 姐妹染色單體在 S 期基因組複製產生。

context.en-US: Sister chromatids congress and segregate during mitosis.
context.zh-TW: 姐妹染色單體在有絲分裂排列並分離。

context.en-US: Histone methyltransferases deposit methyl groups on histone lysine and arginine residues.
context.zh-TW: 組蛋白甲基轉移酶在組蛋白離胺酸與精胺酸沉積甲基。

context.en-US: EZH2 is the catalytic PRC2 subunit within the histone methyltransferase family.
context.zh-TW: EZH2 是組蛋白甲基轉移酶家族中的催化 PRC2 次單元。

context.en-US: SUV39H1 deposits H3K9me3 as a family member enzyme.
context.zh-TW: SUV39H1 作為家族成員酶沉積 H3K9me3。

context.en-US: H3K9me3-HP1-SUV39H1 spreading propagates heterochromatin domains.
context.zh-TW: H3K9me3-HP1-SUV39H1 擴散傳播異染色質結構域。

context.en-US: Translation is the final protein-synthesis step of gene expression.
context.zh-TW: 轉譯是基因表現最後的蛋白合成步驟。

context.en-US: Ribosomes synthesize proteins by decoding messenger RNA.
context.zh-TW: 核醣體經由解碼信使 RNA 合成蛋白。

context.en-US: Messenger RNA provides the decoded template for protein synthesis.
context.zh-TW: 信使 RNA 提供蛋白合成的解碼模板。

context.en-US: Transcription produces the messenger RNA template that translation decodes.
context.zh-TW: 轉錄產生轉譯解碼的信使 RNA 模板。

context.en-US: mTORC1 stimulates translation initiation via the 4E-BP and S6K arms.
context.zh-TW: mTORC1 經 4E-BP 與 S6K 臂刺激轉譯起始。

context.en-US: let-7 tunes translation efficiency through 3-prime UTR targeting.
context.zh-TW: let-7 經由 3' UTR 標靶調節轉譯效率。

context.en-US: Preferentially translated G1 and proliferation transcripts gate cycle progression.
context.zh-TW: 優先轉譯的 G1 與增殖轉錄本守衛週期進展。

context.en-US: Repressive histone marks reinforce transcriptionally silent states.
context.zh-TW: 抑制性組蛋白標記強化轉錄沉默狀態。

context.en-US: Histone deacetylases remove activating acetylation, favoring silent chromatin.
context.zh-TW: 組蛋白去乙醯化酶移除活化性乙醯化，，有利沉默染色質。

context.en-US: Condensed heterochromatin excludes transcriptional machinery from silenced loci.
context.zh-TW: 緻密異染色質將轉錄機器排除於沉默位點。

context.en-US: Promoter hypermethylation silences tumor suppressor genes in cancer.
context.zh-TW: 啟動子高甲基化在癌症沉默腫瘤抑制基因。

context.en-US: Repeat silencing keeps transposable elements immobile.
context.zh-TW: 重複序列沉默使轉座元件保持不動。

context.en-US: X-chromosome inactivation is the physiologic long-range silencing program.
context.zh-TW: X 染色體失活是生理性長程沉默程序。

context.en-US: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
context.zh-TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

context.en-US: XIST recruits the Polycomb methyltransferase EZH2 to deposit H3K27me3.
context.zh-TW: XIST 招募 Polycomb 甲基轉移酶 EZH2 以沉積 H3K27me3。

context.en-US: XIST recruits Polycomb chromatin modifiers to the inactive X.
context.zh-TW: XIST 將 Polycomb 染色質修飾因子招募至不活化 X。

context.en-US: XIST coating induces a repressive heterochromatin state on the coated X.
context.zh-TW: XIST 包被在包被的 X 誘發抑制性異染色質狀態。

context.en-US: The pluripotency factor Oct4 represses XIST in stem cells.
context.zh-TW: 多能性因子 Oct4 在幹細胞抑制 XIST。

context.en-US: Xist ribonucleoprotein contributes to female-biased autoimmunity.
context.zh-TW: Xist 核糖核蛋白促成女性偏向的自體免疫。

context.en-US: X inactivation equalizes X-linked gene dosage between the sexes.
context.zh-TW: X 失活平衡兩性間 X 連鎖基因劑量。

context.en-US: The XIST long non-coding RNA drives initiation of X inactivation.
context.zh-TW: XIST 長非編碼 RNA 驅動 X 失活起始。

context.en-US: H3K27me3 is deposited across the inactive X chromosome.
context.zh-TW: H3K27me3 沉積於整個不活化 X 染色體。

context.en-US: Polycomb EZH2 maintains methylation on the inactive X.
context.zh-TW: Polycomb EZH2 在不活化 X 維持甲基化。

context.en-US: The compacted silent X chromosome is the Barr body.
context.zh-TW: 緻密沉默的 X 染色體即 Barr body。

context.en-US: ZCCHC11 is terminal uridylyltransferase 4, the Lin28-recruited enzyme.
context.zh-TW: ZCCHC11 是末端尿苷醯轉移酶 4，即 Lin28 招募的酶。

context.en-US: ZCCHC11 is recruited to pre-let-7 by Lin28 for uridylation.
context.zh-TW: ZCCHC11 被 Lin28 招募至 pre-let-7 進行尿苷化。

context.en-US: Sas2p is a MYST-family histone acetyltransferase.
context.zh-TW: Sas2p 是 MYST 家族組蛋白乙醯轉移酶。

context.en-US: Sas2p acetylates histone H4 at lysine 16, opening telomeric chromatin.
context.zh-TW: Sas2p 乙醯化組蛋白 H4 離胺酸 16，打開端粒染色質。

context.en-US: H4K16 acetylation by Sas2p marks open transcriptionally active chromatin.
context.zh-TW: Sas2p 的 H4K16 乙醯化標記開放的轉錄活性染色質。

context.en-US: The nucleolus is the largest structure within the cell nucleus.
context.zh-TW: 核仁是細胞核內最大的結構。

context.en-US: SIRT7 concentrates in the nucleolus where it deacetylates H3K18.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 集中於核仁，在該處去乙醯化 H3K18。

context.en-US: Budding yeast is a premier eukaryotic model organism.
context.zh-TW: 芽殖酵母是首屈一指的真核模式生物。

context.en-US: Caloric-restriction lifespan extension was first shown in yeast, Sir2-dependently.
context.zh-TW: 熱量限制延長壽命首先在酵母證實，依賴 Sir2。

context.en-US: Yeast provides replicative and chronological aging models.
context.zh-TW: 酵母提供複製與時序老化模型。

context.en-US: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
context.zh-TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。

context.en-US: The worm is the premier longevity model with conserved insulin and IGF-1 signaling.
context.zh-TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的長壽模型，具保守的胰島素與 IGF-1 訊號。

context.en-US: RNA interference knockdown is a core worm genetics tool.
context.zh-TW: RNA 干擾敲低是核心的線蟲遺傳工具。

context.en-US: Trisomy is whole-chromosome aneuploidy with three copies.
context.zh-TW: 三體是具三拷貝的全染色體非整倍體。

context.en-US: Full trisomy 21 causes Down syndrome, the prototypical viable trisomy.
context.zh-TW: 完全 21 三體導致唐氏症，為典型的可存活三體。

context.en-US: Meiosis-two sister-chromatid nondisjunction produces trisomic gametes.
context.zh-TW: 減數分裂二姐妹染色單體不分離產生三體配子。

context.en-US: A SNP is a single nucleotide variation reaching one percent population frequency.
context.zh-TW: SNP 是達百分之一族群頻率的單核苷酸變異。

context.en-US: The rs4680 Val-to-Met change is a functional single nucleotide variation.
context.zh-TW: rs4680 Val 到 Met 變化是功能性單核苷酸變異。

context.en-US: Functional variants alter transcription factor binding and gene expression.
context.zh-TW: 功能性變異改變轉錄因子結合與基因表現。

context.en-US: The principal executioner caspase cleaves ICAD to release DNase activity.
context.zh-TW: 主要劊子手 caspase 切割 ICAD 以釋放 DNase 活性。

context.en-US: ICAD binds and holds the Caspase-Activated DNase inactive until cleavage.
context.zh-TW: ICAD 結合並使 Caspase 活化 DNase 維持失活直到切割。

context.en-US: ICAD cleavage is a late definitive step of apoptotic DNA fragmentation.
context.zh-TW: ICAD 切割是凋亡 DNA 片段化的晚期確定步驟。

context.en-US: Disrupted de novo methylation at satellites underlies ICF syndrome.
context.zh-TW: 衛星的從頭甲基化破壞是 ICF 症候群的基礎。

context.en-US: Satellite hypomethylation drives centromere instability in ICF syndrome.
context.zh-TW: 衛星低甲基化在 ICF 症候群驅動著絲粒不穩定。

context.en-US: Takahashi is first author of the 2006 Cell paper demonstrating four-factor fibroblast reprogramming.
context.zh-TW: Takahashi 是 2006 Cell 論文證明四因子纖維母細胞重編程的第一作者。

context.en-US: Gait and limb ataxia is the cardinal manifestation of olivopontocerebellar atrophy.
context.zh-TW: 步態與肢體共濟失調是橄欖橋腦小腦萎縮的主要表現。

context.en-US: Patient fibroblast-derived cerebellar neurons recapitulate polyglutamine toxicity.
context.zh-TW: 患者纖維母細胞衍生的小腦神經元重現多麩醯胺酸毒性。

context.en-US: Selective Purkinje and pontine neuronal death defines the pathology.
context.zh-TW: 選擇性 Purkinje 與橋腦神經元死亡定義病理。

context.en-US: Plant polyphenols such as resveratrol activate the sirtuin longevity network.
context.zh-TW: 白藜蘆醇等植物多酚活化 sirtuin 長壽網絡。

context.en-US: Isothiocyanate sulforaphane inhibits histone deacetylases, reactivating silenced genes.
context.zh-TW: 異硫氰酸酯 sulforaphane 抑制組蛋白去乙醯化酶，重新活化沉默基因。

context.en-US: Phytochemicals directly inhibit histone methyltransferase activity.
context.zh-TW: 植物化學物直接抑制組蛋白甲基轉移酶活性。

context.en-US: Phytochemicals show tumorigenicity-suppressing properties in chemoprevention.
context.zh-TW: 植物化學物在化學預防顯示抑制致瘤性特性。

context.en-US: Plant compounds act as natural epigenetic modifiers of chromatin state.
context.zh-TW: 植物化合物充當染色質狀態的天然表觀遺傳修飾劑。

context.en-US: Naive lymphocytes rest metabolically restrained in quiescence until antigen activation.
context.zh-TW: 初始淋巴細胞在抗原活化前以代謝受限靜止休憩。

context.en-US: T-lineage activation requires major histocompatibility complex presentation.
context.zh-TW: T 譜系活化需要主要組織相容複合體呈現。

context.en-US: Mature quiescent hepatocytes are the dominant regenerative source after hepatectomy.
context.zh-TW: 成熟靜止肝細胞是肝切除後的主要再生來源。

context.en-US: Hepatocytes rest quiescent while retaining cell-cycle re-entry capacity.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞靜止休憩同時保留細胞週期重入能力。

context.en-US: Fibroblasts secrete collagen types one, three and five as structural matrix.
context.zh-TW: 纖維母細胞分泌第一、三、五型膠原作為結構基質。

context.en-US: Fibroblasts are the first and standard reprogramming starting material.
context.zh-TW: 纖維母細胞是最初且標準的重編程起始材料。

context.en-US: Persistent fibroblast activation transitions to myofibroblasts driving scar formation.
context.zh-TW: 持續的纖維母細胞活化轉為肌纖維母細胞驅動疤痕形成。

context.en-US: Mesenchymal fibroblasts must undergo epithelial transition to reach pluripotency.
context.zh-TW: 間質纖維母細胞必須經歷上皮轉換以達多能性。

context.en-US: Mature hepatocytes are the dominant proliferative source of regeneration.
context.zh-TW: 成熟肝細胞是再生的主要增殖來源。

context.en-US: The HGF and cyclin-D1 proliferative phase drives regenerative outgrowth.
context.zh-TW: HGF 與 cyclin-D1 增殖期驅動再生性生長。

context.en-US: Regeneration is defined by exit from and re-entry to quiescence.
context.zh-TW: 再生由退出靜止與重入靜止定義。

context.en-US: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
context.zh-TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

context.en-US: LATS1 and LATS2 phosphorylation excludes and degrades YAP.
context.zh-TW: LATS1 與 LATS2 磷酸化排除並降解 YAP。

context.en-US: Mechanical density cues act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ.
context.zh-TW: 機械密度線索經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ。

context.en-US: Loss of NF2, SAV1 or LATS drives overgrowth across tumor types.
context.zh-TW: NF2、SAV1 或 LATS 缺失在多種腫瘤驅動過度生長。

context.en-US: Hippo signaling balances proliferation against apoptotic removal.
context.zh-TW: Hippo 訊號平衡增殖與凋亡清除。

context.en-US: E-cadherin clustering at adherens junctions initiates inhibitory signaling.
context.zh-TW: 黏附連接的 E-cadherin 聚集啟動抑制訊號。

context.en-US: Tension signals act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ effectors.
context.zh-TW: 張力訊號經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ 效應器。

context.en-US: Cadherin engagement elevates p21 and p27, holding cells in quiescence.
context.zh-TW: Cadherin 接合提高 p21 與 p27，使細胞維持靜止。

context.en-US: Loss of contact inhibition is a defining cancer hallmark of invasion.
context.zh-TW: 接觸抑制的喪失是侵襲的定義性癌症標誌。

context.en-US: E-cadherin loss during transition abolishes contact inhibition.
context.zh-TW: 轉換期間 E-cadherin 缺失廢除接觸抑制。

context.en-US: Age is the dominant risk factor for macular degenerative blindness.
context.zh-TW: 年齡是黃斑部退化失明的主要危險因子。

context.en-US: Retinal pigment epithelium dysfunction and loss is the pathophysiologic center.
context.zh-TW: 視網膜色素上皮功能障礙與缺失是病理生理中心。

context.en-US: The 2014 RIKEN autologous sheet trial grafted iPSC retinal cells without tumor growth.
context.zh-TW: 2014 RIKEN 自體片劑試驗移植 iPSC 視網膜細胞而無腫瘤生長。

context.en-US: Patient retinal cells enable neuroprotective and anti-angiogenic screening.
context.zh-TW: 患者視網膜細胞促成神經保護與抗血管新生篩選。

context.en-US: Epigenetic clocks are the operational estimator of biological age.
context.zh-TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的操作性估計器。

context.en-US: Biological age is computed from CpG methylation measurements.
context.zh-TW: 生物年齡由 CpG 甲基化測量計算。

context.en-US: PODXL is a canonical undifferentiated-state surface marker.
context.zh-TW: PODXL 是典型的未分化狀態表面標記。

context.en-US: Charge-based anti-adhesion maintains foot-process architecture.
context.zh-TW: 電荷型抗黏附維持足突架構。

context.en-US: Sialylated glycocalyx prevents cell-to-cell and matrix adhesion.
context.zh-TW: 唾液酸化糖萼阻止細胞間與基質黏附。

context.en-US: Upregulated PODXL drives pro-migratory transition in carcinoma metastasis.
context.zh-TW: 上調的 PODXL 在癌轉移驅動促遷移轉換。

context.en-US: Collagen types one to three are the dominant structural fibers.
context.zh-TW: 第一至三型膠原是主要的結構纖維。

context.en-US: Adipose tissue is a specialized connective tissue depot.
context.zh-TW: 脂肪組織是特化的結締組織庫。

context.en-US: Excessive deposition across liver, lung and kidney is fibrosis.
context.zh-TW: 肝、肺、腎的過度沉積即纖維化。

context.en-US: Mesenchymal and stromal cells synthesize pro-HGF for niche signaling.
context.zh-TW: 間質與基質細胞合成 pro-HGF 以供微環境訊號。

context.en-US: Hepatocyte Growth Factor awakens quiescent satellite cells after injury, exiting dormancy.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞生長因子在損傷後喚醒靜止衛星細胞，退出休眠。

context.en-US: Major histocompatibility complex mismatch is the principal transplant-rejection determinant.
context.zh-TW: 主要組織相容複合體錯配是主要的移植排斥決定因子。

context.en-US: T cell receptors recognize peptide complexes presented by the major histocompatibility complex.
context.zh-TW: T 細胞受體辨識主要組織相容複合體呈現的肽複合體。

context.en-US: Peptide loading and display is the defining mechanism of the complex.
context.zh-TW: 肽裝載與展示是此複合體的定義機制。

context.en-US: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a potent oxidant tool compound for stress studies.
context.zh-TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是壓力研究的強效氧化劑工具化合物。

context.en-US: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide is a standard in-vitro premature senescence inducer via p53/p21 and p16/Rb.
context.zh-TW: tert-Butyl hydroperoxide 是經 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 的標準體外早發衰老誘發劑。

context.en-US: Peroxide bond cleavage yields alkoxyl radicals plus Fenton and lipid-peroxidation cascades.
context.zh-TW: 過氧化鍵斷裂產生烷氧自由基加 Fenton 與脂質過氧化級聯。

context.en-US: Base oxidation and single- and double-strand breaks follow peroxide exposure.
context.zh-TW: 鹼基氧化與單雙股斷裂隨過氧化物暴露而生。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial DNA and electron-transport oxidative damage create a reactive oxygen vicious cycle.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 DNA 與電子傳遞氧化損傷形成活性氧惡性循環。

context.en-US: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
context.zh-TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

context.en-US: B18R is a soluble interferon-sequestering decoy receptor.
context.zh-TW: B18R 是可溶性干擾素隔離誘餌受體。

context.en-US: B18R creates an immunosuppressive microenvironment enabling viral spread.
context.zh-TW: B18R 創造免疫抑制微環境促成病毒擴散。

context.en-US: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
context.zh-TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

context.en-US: Levodopa-induced peak-dose and diphasic dyskinesia complicates Parkinson therapy.
context.zh-TW: 左旋多巴誘發的峰劑量與雙相運動障礙使帕金森治療複雜化。

subject: Partial Reprogramming

context.en-US: Partial reprogramming drives muscle, pancreatic and cardiac regrowth plus scar reduction in mice.
context.zh-TW: 部分重編程在小鼠驅動肌肉、胰臟與心臟再生長加疤痕減少。

context.zh-TW: 山中因子回撥發育與老化甲基標記，依賴去甲基酶。
